title: Curology Prescription Weekly Days Since Ship Trend
dataSources: Curology prescriptions (`curology:prescription`), skin diaries (`skin:diary`), dermatology appointments (`derm:appointment`), and UV exposure logs (`uv:exposure`).
app: Curology prescription shipments, daily skin diary entries, dermatology appointment exports, and UV exposure tracker logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=curology:prescription days_since_ship=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_since_ship) as avg_duration, max(days_since_ship) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days since ship for Curology prescription events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_since_ship on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days since ship with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether Curology prescription tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
